# gcore_cloud_file_share_access_rules (Data Source)

File share access rules control which IP addresses can mount a file share and their permissions (read-only or read-write).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_file_share_access_rules" "example_cloud_file_share_access_rules" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 1
  file_share_id = "bd8c47ee-e565-4e26-8840-b537e6827b08"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_share_id` (String) File Share ID

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `access_level` (String) Access mode
Available values: "ro", "rw".
- `access_to` (String) Source IP or network
- `id` (String) Access Rule ID
- `state` (String) Access Rule state
Available values: "active", "applying", "denying", "error", "new", "queued_to_apply", "queued_to_deny".
